_source: Forge-C factory/checklists/v0.4/SWE.5.yaml and the inherited v0.3 factory/release-manager/checklists/SWE.5.yaml, neutralised for feature 023

items.title: Component and integration verification planned
items.pass_criterion: Both software component behaviour verification and software integration verification are planned, with measures and environment stated.
items.typical_defect: Only integrated end-to-end tests; component behaviour not verified separately.

items.title: Integration sequence matches architecture
items.pass_criterion: The integration sequence and the interfaces exercised match the software architecture.
items.typical_defect: Integration exercises an interface path not defined in the architecture.

items.title: Inter-element interactions tested
items.pass_criterion: Inter-element shared-resource, clock, reset and interrupt interactions are tested.
items.typical_defect: No test of reset or interrupt interaction between two elements sharing a resource.

items.title: Robustness and budgets checked
items.pass_criterion: Robustness, fault propagation across interfaces and timing/resource budgets are checked during integration.
items.typical_defect: Budget compliance assumed, never measured on the integrated build.

items.title: Interface coverage by passing tests
items.pass_criterion: Every integration test declares the architecture elements and interfaces it verifies, and every architecture interface is verified by at least one executed, passing integration test.
items.typical_defect: Architecture interface verified by no executed integration test.

items.title: Measures map to architecture, results and regression
items.pass_criterion: Component and integration measures map consistently to architecture elements, actual results and regression selection.
items.typical_defect: Results listed with no link to the measure or architecture element they verify.

items.title: Environment limitations explicit
items.pass_criterion: Limitations of simulation versus target evidence are explicit, and unresolved defects are tracked.
items.typical_defect: Simulator-only results presented as target evidence; open defects not tracked.
